title: Remove a person
summary: The Responsável removes a person from the account (ADR 0251 points 16 to 18). The person's personal account does not change.

confirm.effect: DELETE /v1/me/business/seats/{seatId}, then closes. The SeatList then has backup_rotation_pending, and the owner's phone rotates the key backup in the background (bipe-chat/bipe#1057).

notes: The text says what stays on that phone. Bipe cannot take back what a device already decrypted.
